title: Collections: order, named fields and lookup by key
goal: Choose an Array, Structure or Map for its purpose and calculate a total while distinguishing order, fields and keys.
prerequisites: The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.
outcomes: Traverse different durations and explain the first array index.
Read a named structure field and a map value by key.
Distinguish a missing key, zero and a shared mutable collection.
sections: Our requests now take different durations: 30 and 45 minutes. Массив preserves a sequence. Добавить appends an element; the first index is 0, so МинутыЗаявок[0] is 30. There are two elements and the last valid index is 1.

Для Каждого visits the values in turn. The accumulator starts outside the loop: after 30 it is 30, after 45 it is 75. Reordering these numeric inputs changes traversal order but not their sum. An invalid index is an error, not a request for an imaginary zero.
A structure names the fields of one record

Карточка has Клиент and Минуты fields. Карточка.Минуты communicates meaning more clearly than an arbitrary index. Structure field names must be suitable property identifiers. Several unrelated fields do not become a sequence of requests merely by being placed together.

The duration field receives the computed 75. This is an in-memory structure; creating it does not write a catalog item or database document. For an optional field, use Свойство("FieldName", Value) rather than assuming a misspelling returns an empty string.
A map associates a key with a value

Соответствие is useful for lookup by key rather than position or a predefined field name. "Клиент-А" is an educational label here. A changeable customer name is not reliable identity in a real application; later lessons introduce catalog references. Inserting the same key replaces its associated value rather than appending a second array row.

Получить on a missing key returns Неопределено, which differs from a stored numeric zero. Do not add an unknown value to a duration without deciding what absence means. It might indicate that the total has not been calculated. Check the expected value and its type first.
Two variables can name the same mutable object

ВтороеИмя = МинутыЗаявок does not create an independent array. Both variables access the same mutable object; an append through one is visible through the other. Build a new array and transfer values for an independent flat collection. Nested mutable objects need an additional copying decision.

A preservation check compares actual contents before and after, not just variable names. An empty array leaves this accumulator at zero under our chosen rule. A text value among numeric durations needs a different response: detect and reject it rather than trusting its numeric appearance.

lab.negative: Do not index an empty array at [0], treat Неопределено as zero or describe assignment as an independent copy.

mistakes: Two elements do not make index 2 valid.
For two elements use indexes 0 and 1; handle an empty array before indexing.
An in-memory structure does not write database records.
Persisting data needs an explicit object operation; a structure only stores in-memory values.
Reusing a map key replaces its value; it is not a new request.
Use a distinct key for a distinct entity and check the previous total was not replaced accidentally.
